August 10, 2026 
 
To, 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Subject: Intimation of Earnings Call for the Quarter ended June 30, 2026 
 
Dear Sir/Madam, 
 
Pursuant to Regulation 30 read with Schedule III of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing 
Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, as amended, this is to inform you that 
an Earnings Call will be held on Thursday, August 13, 2026, at 5:00 PM (IST) to discuss operational and 
financial performance of the Company for the Quarter ended June 30, 2026. The invite giving requisite 
details including the pre-registration link and dial-in details is attached herewith. 
 
This disclosure will also be hosted on the Company’s website viz. www.tegaindustries.com.  
 
Kindly take the information on your record. 
 
Thanking you, 
 
Yours faithfully, 
 
For Tega Industries Limited 
 
 
 
 
Manjuree Rai 
Company Secretary & Compliance Officer
